facts.fact: The Sierra Leone Standards Bureau states that its Standards Department develops and publishes national standards under the Standards Act No. 2 of 1996, and that it has published 204 national standards in the public gazette; it names a technical committee on Information Security Management Systems but no national IT or data standard issued; published date used because the page gives no event date.

note: No certification fact: a headline on the page mentions a management system certification body (MSCB) launch, with no date, standard or certifier detail.

No fact: the story is about university training and student solutions evaluated against the international Digital Public Goods Standard; it names no national standards body, national IT or data standard, or certification, and a 2025 open-source software policy is a policy, not a national standard (class other).

facts.fact: ISO's member page says the Sierra Leone Standards Bureau was created by the Standards Act No 2 of 1996 to coordinate standardization and quality management and offers development and sale of national standards.

note: Sierra Leone Standards Bureau appears only as a budget line; no law, standard or certification stated.
